result: tested endpoint observations are now distinguishing and getter-specific; fractional precision and generalized retime semantics remain untested
scope: Read-only review of retained synthetic picture evidence, exact full-pair getters, and already-rendered PCM. The only analysis added reads manifest-validated generated bed.wav and localized PCM windows. No Resolve call, rerender, re-extraction, new fixture, protected-media byte/hash access, source/config/dashboard/docs/report change, or contract/fixture change.

correction_to_prior_review.wrong_conflict: The prior review treated base-only samples 199/200 (equal black pixels) as if they were the later overlay-enabled samples. They are separate sample sets.

base_only_set.pixel_finding: frame 198 contains the known base slate; frames 199 and 200 are identical all-black RGB samples. This proves the tested base-only visible sequence ends before frame 199.

later_overlay_set.case: transparent overlay starts at local frame 75, duration 125, end getter 200; separate timeline section starts at 6500 and item starts at 6575.
later_overlay_set.finding: The later overlay sample at local 199 is visibly non-black and differs from the base-only black sample at frame 199; local 200 is black. This resolves the previous visibility conflict without merging the two tests.

tested_getter_conventions.tested_reading: The tested start value names the first included timeline frame. Samples/signal are present beginning at the tested start.

For these tested 100% speed timeline items, the value is the first timeline frame outside the observed item: base is black at 199; overlay is black at local 200; audio output frame 9199 is zero after mapped source frame 198 at timeline 9198.
tested_getter_conventions.scope: Observed exclusive upper-bound behavior for these items; not a universal rule for arbitrary retimes/effects.

tested_getter_conventions.tested_reading: Values agree with the observed frame counts for these tested spans: base frames 0..198; overlay local frames 75..199; audio timeline frames 9100..9198. Duration is kept as its own getter result.
tested_getter_conventions.scope: Do not derive it from endpoint getters outside these measured cases.

tested_getter_conventions.observed_values: Exactly match the corresponding integer values as floats in retained examples, including 0.0/199.0/199.0, 75.0/200.0/125.0 and 9100.0/9199.0/99.0.
tested_getter_conventions.scope: No fractional start/end/duration was exercised. Fractional precision is untested, not an API failure.

tested_getter_conventions.observed_values: The 100% audio tail piece reports source frames 100/199 while its timeline span is 9100/9199 with duration 99. Rendered timeline frame 9198 correlates to source frame 198; source frame 199 remains nonzero but is not present in the render.
tested_getter_conventions.tested_reading: For this generated 100% audio item, source end frame 199 is the first source frame excluded by the tested range.
tested_getter_conventions.scope: Source frame fields are recorded separately from timeline GetEnd and from source-time getters.

tested_getter_conventions.observed_values: At 100%, tail source frames 100/199 pair with source times 4.0/7.96. The one-frame still reports source frames 0/0 and times 0.0/0.04. In a separate 50% retime capture, source end frame 99 pairs with source end time 4.0.
tested_getter_conventions.tested_reading: Retain the raw frame and second values independently. The 50% pair does not map by a single assumed frame-index-to-time rule (99 at 25 fps would place the frame start at 3.96 s, while the getter reports 4.0 s).
tested_getter_conventions.scope: The existing 50% capture is a raw observation, not proof of unsupported behavior or a universal source-time convention. The 50% clip was restored to 100%.

audio_pcm_observation.rendered_pcm_format: PCM24 stereo, 48000 Hz, 17664000 samples/channel, PTS 0; 368 seconds; 9200 timeline frames at 25 fps.

generated_bed.format: PCM16 mono, 48000 Hz, 384000 samples; exact manifest hash verified before reading windows.

audio_pcm_observation.source_control: Manifest-bound source frames 197, 198 and 199 contain nonzero samples (frame 199 range -500..500); frame 199 is continuous generated sine, not source silence. Correlation is channel-preserved and the final visible window matches at near-zero lag.
audio_pcm_observation.geometry_and_other_audio: In full-pair-007, the VERA 141 Batched Matrix timeline is 0..9200. Audio 1 and Audio 3 tracks are enabled; the tail repeated.wav and bed.wav clips are clip-enabled at 100% speed and each ends at 9199 with duration 99 and source range 100..199. Audio 2's overlapping clip is disabled. No other enabled generated audio item extends beyond 9199.
audio_pcm_observation.conclusion: The tested generated audio item has exclusive timeline and source end behavior at 9199/199 for this 100% speed case. Frame 9198 is audible and source-correlated; frame 9199 is exactly silent although the next source frame is nonzero.

adequacy.video: Adequate for the named base-only and overlay-on-picture samples at the tested adjacent endpoint frames.
adequacy.still_image: Adequate for the named generated overlay still extended across 125 timeline frames; visible through local 199 and black at 200.
adequacy.audio: Adequate for the named 100% generated audio tail; localized PCM proves correlated signal at 9198 and exact silence at 9199.
adequacy.source_bounds: Raw source frame/time getters are retained and the 100% audio source endpoint is sample-distinguished. The 50% source-time/frame relation remains unresolved; values must not be normalized together.
adequacy.float_precision: Integer/float overload equality is observed only for integer-valued edits. Fractional edit precision remains untested, not an API failure.
adequacy.generalization: No conclusion for arbitrary retime rates, effects, other routing, different frame rates, or all Resolve getters.

minimum_remaining_observation: If fractional precision is required, a separate authorized generated-only edit must exercise at least one non-integral timeline/source boundary and retain the raw int and float getter types/values plus adjacent distinguishing media output. No such edit was performed here.
